pkgmetadata.longdescription: Aurora target-device firmware and peripheral admission: blacklists drivers that request per-machine firmware during probe, extracts the vendor firmware from the ESP in the initrd (via the bundled dracut module), points the kernel firmware search path at it, and only then admits the peripherals (AOP, radios, dockchannel keyboard/trackpad) with explicit modprobes. Port of alarm-aurora aurora-firmware; the mkinitcpio hook was ported to dracut.
